releases.name: Water Margin Heroes: Eight Acts of Battle
releases.summary: Basketball Shooter is a free throw game of a basketball.Get an item by stage clear.From the stage2, the goal moves to right and left.Please also enjoy it, although there is a motion which is not considered in physics.?How to play??It goes to the goal and is swipe quickly.?From the stage2, the goal moves to right and left.?Speed who moves at every stage clear becomes quick.?Get an item by stage clear.?A score changes for every item.?At the goal, the score according to a stage and an item is added.?At a super shot, the score according to a stage and an item is added.?At a super shot, the ball according to a stage is added.?It is game over when a ball is lost.

releases.name: The Last Brazilian
releases.summary: Choose your class from illustrative figures and face hordes of enemies in intense 2D platforming combat across the country. Defeat iconic state bosses and unlock unique powers with each game. Will you be The Last Brazilian?

releases.name: Motelet
releases.summary: Motelet is an incremental game about cleaning dusty rooms with a cute robot vacuum. Clear away dust and debris, earn coins, and purchase powerful upgrades as you transform your humble cleaner into the ultimate cleaning machine.

releases.name: Carriers Together
releases.summary: A 2–6 player co-op puzzle game where you carry and throw each other to solve clever puzzles. Coordinate your timing, work as a team, and clear every stage.

releases.name: Akelarre
releases.summary: A psychological horror game where you enter the dark forests of Urkaitz as Gustavo, a reporter determined to uncover the truth behind a series of sinister incidents connected to a possible witches' coven.

releases.name: Paleo Dive
releases.summary: A calm VR diving adventure through prehistoric underwater worlds. Explore coral reefs, kelp forests and the deep sea, gather finds and upgrade your gear at your own pace. VR only (OpenXR).

releases.name: Carrot Revenge
releases.summary:
You are RABBIT, a lonely survivor from an alien abduction, you don't know where you are, or why. After waking up, you realize you aren't home, and that escaping is not an option.

In this bullet-hell journey, encounter more than 10 types of enemies (and more than a hundred of them).

Explore different builds and mechanics and more importantly, survive!

releases.name: Moonbringer
releases.summary: Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

releases.name: DieLessEndLess
releases.summary: A single-player roguelike. A high-difficulty 2D action game with simple controls. It's game over when the distance to the wall of zombies closing in from behind reaches zero! Hit an approaching zombie with an attack to accelerate. Attack, dodge, & run Take on the challenge of this endless game!

releases.name: Phonemae
releases.summary: A short incremental about the worker that keep reality running. Extract memories from the souls on your bench, buy machines to automate production, and meet a quota that only grows. It starts cozy, only starts. No ads, no microtransactions.

releases.name: ANT SIMULATOR: stock market game
releases.summary: In Korea, small retail investors are called "ants." Survive as one in a fast, volatile stock market modeled on Korea's: read the macro currents beneath the charts, allocate your assets, and outlast the crashes. Play solo, or compete with up to 4 players in the same live market.

releases.name: Blackwire
releases.summary: Blackwire is a single-player hacking simulation in the spirit of the classics. You are a freelance agent with a gateway, a contract board, and a trace timer that does not care how close you were to done.Take contracts from fictional corporations, copy files, empty an account, rewrite a criminal record, put someone in prison. Build a bounce route a dozen hops long before you touch the target, because every hop you put between yourself and them is time on the clock when they notice you. And they will notice you.Then get out, and clean up after yourself. Their admins walk your log trail hop by hop, and the entry that names your gateway is sitting on the first server you bounced through. Scrubbing it is not a side activity. It is how you stay alive.FEATURESA living network — hundreds of servers, banks, registries, and mainframes. Every machine keeps logs. Every log can hang you.The trace is the game — an active countdown while you work, a passive investigation after you leave. Outrun one, erase the other.Follow the money — crack a bank account and chase stolen funds through chains of transfers, or wire someone else's credits to yourself.Mainframes — crawl their internal interface lock by lock towards root, past scanners, ICE, and counter-intrusion hardware that hacks you back.Build your rig — mainboards, cpus, drives, and a catalogue of software from bruteforce to ghost. Split your CPU between the crack and the shield and hope you split it right.Two corporations at war — both want to hire you against the other. Both pay well. Both remember.A story that finds you — someone is clearing freelance agents off the board, one by one. Your name is on a list you have to steal to read.Entirely offline. No accounts, no server, nothing real — a game about the fantasy of hacking, the way it looked in the movies and never was.

releases.name: The Swashbugglers
releases.summary: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

releases.name: Mess in the Toy Shop
releases.summary: Just the simple joy of putting toys back on the shelves. Dive into a relaxing gameplay experience where every toy has its place. Turn a messy toy shop into a perfectly organized store. Unlock new skills, improve your efficiency, and have fun.

releases.name: Ninja's Vengeance
releases.summary: Take revenge for your father by mastering diverse katana attacks, shurikens, and fluid dash mechanics while standing against a rival gang.

releases.name: Escape from Company
releases.summary: A puzzle escape game set in a company that won’t let you quit. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome absurd workplace rules, and escape with your resignation.

releases.name: VOXEL ISLE SIMULATOR
releases.summary: Raise an island from the sea, seed it with life, then smite it, flood it, or raise its dead. A voxel god game where tribes you never command learn masonry and gunpowder, forge kingdoms and go to war, and every power you use is written into a history you can click to visit.

releases.name: Five Minute Dating
releases.summary: If you’re looking to discover fresh, interesting personalities, Five Minute Dating is for you. Get your swag on!

releases.name: FreeState: San Francisco
releases.summary: FreeState: San Francisco is a free-to-play open-world driving game where you can explore a city inspired by San Francisco behind the wheel of a wide variety of vehicles. Cruise through downtown streets, highways, hills and scenic coastal roads while discovering everything the city has to offer.

releases.name: PENCILS DOWN
releases.summary: It is 1999. You are seated in Room 44 for a standardized test that knows you. Wager your confidence, guard your erasers, and keep your pencil DOWN when the proctor walks the rows. The questions are about history, science, and what you did three minutes ago.

releases.name: Thornwake: Forest Adventure
releases.summary: A hand-drawn 16-bit action platformer. Run, climb and vine-swing through 40 levels of autumn woods, sunken swamps and frozen peaks, mixing sword-and-shield melee with four elemental spells to cleanse a corrupted forest and rescue the Keeper it took.

releases.name: Stellar End
releases.summary: "Your ship has just been repaired! Fight your way through numerous trails. This system really needs your help!" Cool combination of classic Sci-Fi 2D "Shoot 'em up" with 3D FPP on-rails shooter. Weaponry system is gradually getting quite complex, dogfights are quite addictive and challenging.

releases.name: Kitty Needs A Home!
releases.summary: A cozy idle game about a shelter for cats. Catch fluffballs in the yard, fulfill heartwarming requests from around the world, collect an album of happy endings — and win Jane's heart. Cuteness, pixels, and purring. Plays itself while you're away!
